topic_class: comedy skit (agency vs client / marketing industry)

signature.one_line: Single locked-off wide skit with accent role-label pills pinned above each head.
unique_devices: One-word role labels (white extra-bold sans on solid accent-accent #FA3551 rounded pills) pinned just above each person's head
Labels sit at depth-matched heights (foreground 36-40 % H, background 41-46 % H), static for the whole clip
Single uncut locked-off wide at golden hour; trend / lip-sync audio does the talking
signature.why_it_works: Two labels make the industry joke readable in half a second; anyone who has been on either side projects themselves onto the roles.

hook.type: In medias res (audio from frame 0, labels explain the scene)
hook.first_frame: locked-off outdoor wide at sunset: one person in the foreground with arms crossed, a pair in the background, accent label pills above both

structure.what: labelled roles on screen, complaint starts immediately and names the niche
escalating complaint; background pair keeps moving, foreground deadpan
punchline line and a gesture, clip ends

background_text.how: white Inter 800 57 px Title-case single word on a solid accent-accent rounded rectangle (height 4.3-4.5 % H, radius ~20 % of its height, padding ~2.5 % W / ~0.9 % H); role A x 12.8-36.8 % / y 36.2-40.5 %, role B x 65.3-85.1 % / y 41.2-45.7 %; static, no animation

layout.how: foreground subject left, background pair right; sky in the top ~40 %

other_text_spec.type: role labels (no captions; the only text)

spec.script: latin (English one-word role labels; speech is Hinglish and is NOT captioned)

grouping.words_per_caption: 1 per label, 2 labels on screen (ROLE A, ROLE B)
grouping.sync: not tied to speech; both on for the whole video

role_a_pill.anchor: just above the foreground (left) person's head

role_b_pill.anchor: just above the background (right) person's head (further back, so lower)

label.font_class: neo-grotesque sans, bold/extra-bold (single-storey g, straight-tailed y)

calibration.note: height not used: the g/y descenders blend into the pill's bottom edge

label.box: solid #FA3551 rounded rectangle, height 4.3-4.5 % of H, corner radius ~20 % of its height (estimated), hugging the word

animation.idle: none; labels are screen-fixed (the camera is locked off)

other_text_spec.text: no captions, titles, logos, watermark or end card

style.look_intent: high-contrast, muted, neutral-warm; natural golden-hour sky, slightly underexposed foreground, phone HDR

sound.music: voice only (trend / lip-sync dialogue track, no bed detected)

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

catalog_styles.name: Color-Coded Speaker Captions
catalog_styles.role: labels identify who is who (static variant)

catalog_styles.name: Music-Led Montage with Minimal Dialogue
catalog_styles.role: borrowed trend audio carries the clip

use_when: a 'them vs us' industry joke (agency vs client, seller vs buyer, boss vs employee)
one static shot with 2-3 people and a trend / lip-sync audio
the audience needs to know who is who instantly
B2B or marketing brands doing relatable team content
avoid_when: the speech carries information that must be captioned
people move a lot (static labels will drift off their heads)
polished ads that need product shots or CTAs
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B49 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B49.json) to this brand.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour for each role; keep the contrast relationship — text and accent must stay >= 4.5:1 / >= 3:1 against what sits behind them on the footage):
- {{TEXT}}      default #FFFFFF (label text)
- {{ACCENT}}    default #FA3551 (label pill fill)
- {{ACCENT_2}}  default none (optionally a second pill colour per role)
- {{SURFACE}}   default none
- {{CARD_BG}}   default #FA3551 (pill fill; same as accent)
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}} default Inter 800
- {{FONT_BODY}}    default Inter 800
- {{HANDLE}}    default @handle
- {{LOGO}}      default the brand's logo file (transparent PNG/SVG)
Pill text must stay >= 4.5:1 on {{CARD_BG}}; the pill itself needs >= 3:1 against the footage behind it (avoid pills that match the sky colour).
Canvas 1080x1920, 30 fps.

CAPTIONS
1. No captions.

OTHER TEXT
2. Two role labels, one per person, Title-case single word (placeholders 'ROLE A' / 'ROLE B' set as e.g. 'Brand' / 'Client'), {{FONT_DISPLAY}} at 57 px, {{TEXT}}, tracking 0, no stroke / shadow, on a solid {{CARD_BG}} rounded rectangle hugging the word (height 4.3-4.5 % H, corner radius ~20 % of its height, padding ~2.5 % W left/right, ~0.9 % H top/bottom).
3. Pin each pill just above its person's head: foreground person x 12.8-36.8 %, y 36.2-40.5 % (text centre 38.8 %); background person x 65.3-85.1 %, y 41.2-45.7 % (text centre 43.4 %). Further-back people get lower, smaller-looking positions.
4. Animation: none — both on from frame 0 to the last frame, screen-fixed (the camera is locked off). If the subjects move, track the pills to the heads instead.
5. No {{LOGO}}, titles or end card ({{HANDLE}} optional, small, bottom).
6. Edit: one locked-off wide, no cuts.

GRADE
Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: high-contrast, muted, neutral-warm; natural golden-hour sky.

VERIFY before rendering
a) Render a pill with 'Client' and one with 'Agency' and measure: python3 video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test-render> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.6,0.40,0.9,0.47 --ink "{{TEXT}}:60"
   Expected (±0.5 % H, ±2 % W) with Inter 800 at 57 px: 'Client' ink 2.19 % H / 14.9 % W; 'Agency' ~19.2 % W.
b) Brand role words: python3 video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py --font "Inter 800" --word "<Word>" --ink 2.19 -> ~57 px for a Title-case word without descenders; size the pill around the returned width. (fit_font.py needs a target: --ink and/or --width; it returns the px that reproduces that ink for YOUR word plus the width it will read at that px. Requires Pillow.)
c) Positions within ±1 % H: pill A y 36.2-40.5 %, pill B y 41.2-45.7 %.
